appearance.overview: Tall elegant blonde woman in a white bell-shaped dress with a broad hat and parasol; her clean appearance is contradicted by a heavy scent of blood.

personality.summary: Elegant and polite, yet carries the aura of death from real anti-terror combat experience.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Thanks him because his restraint saved her from suppressing everyone in the restaurant.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Her reputation is known even to Stella.

periods.summary: Kanata appears with Utakata after Kuraudo's restaurant provocation. Ikki and Stella instinctively sense danger from her blood-soaked aura despite her white clothing. She is identified as Hagun's second-ranked B-rank knight, a student with actual government special-call experience suppressing criminal Blazer groups. She thanks Ikki for keeping the incident from escalating.

key_events.summary: Appears with Utakata and comments that she would have had to suppress the restaurant if a fight started.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Helps coordinate Okutama response and later appears at the representative ceremony.

periods.summary: Kanata functions as the calm, elegant student council treasurer. She explains the Okutama giant problem and pours tea during the student council meeting, remains at the base during the mountain search, receives reports about Stella's illness and the strange footprints, and escorts Akaza when he arrives seeking Ikki. She later becomes one of Hagun's representative team members.

key_events.summary: Explains the giant sighting and need for extra help.
Coordinates from base and receives Ikki's report.
Leads Akaza to Ikki after he comes to Okutama.
Named as a Hagun representative.

periods.label: 彼方守候刀华

status.current: safe after Akatsuki's Fantasy Form attack and watching over Toka

relationships.toka-todo: Student council president; Kanata is at her bedside when she wakes.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Student council vice president still asleep nearby.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Asks Toka to compare Ikki and Moroboshi during the broadcast.

periods.summary: Kanata sits beside Toka in the hospital room when Toka wakes from the Akatsuki attack. She explains that Hagun's students survived because the damage was in Fantasy Form, and she watches the Seven Stars broadcast with Toka, prompting Toka's analysis of Ikki's match against Moroboshi.

key_events.summary: Explains the post-attack situation to Toka while watching the broadcast.

periods.time: Hospital viewing during Stella's B-block match
periods.label: 腥红淑女的反射术士证言

status.current: recovering/visiting Touka while watching Seven Stars broadcast

personality.summary: Gentle and guilt-ridden over Hagun's injuries, but candid about enemy strength and grateful for Stella's revenge.
fears: Stella's kindness pushing her into danger

relationships.toka-todo: Watches the match with Touka and discusses tournament prospects in the hospital.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Feels grateful but pained because Stella risks herself to avenge injured Hagun students.
relationships.yui-tatara: Former opponent during the Hagun attack; Kanata failed to leave even a scratch because of Tatara's reflection.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Present when he wakes and urgently asks about the tournament.

periods.summary: Kanata watches Stella's B-block battle from Touka's hospital room and explains that Stella's four-on-one challenge is an act of kindness toward the Hagun students wounded by Akatsuki. Her own experience fighting Yui Tatara during the school attack lets her identify Tatara as a reflection mage; even Diamond Dust, which can infiltrate lungs as microscopic blade fragments, could not harm Tatara. Kanata's testimony frames the danger Stella faces. After Stella wins, Kanata acknowledges that her guilt had made her underestimate Stella's strength and later assists when Utakata wakes.

key_events.summary: Tells Touka that Tatara's reflection made Kanata unable to scratch her.
Confirms Utakata has been asleep for more than a week and hears his warning.

periods.time: Student council ghost-story party and poltergeist search
periods.label: 贵德原家的少女骑士道
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy student council; Tokutomiya family/foundation

status.future: expects an arranged marriage after graduation to preserve family and foundation interests
status.role: protects a special telekinetic monkey through her family foundation

personality.summary: Outwardly elegant and mature, inwardly mischievous, curious and deeply committed to noblesse oblige.
values: protecting those who need money and institutions to survive

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Search partner; asks him about kissing, then coordinates flawlessly with him in the poltergeist capture.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Teases her fear of ghosts and later her jealousy.
relationships.toka-todo: Student council president and old friend from shared student-council life.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Student council vice president and fellow prankster/history companion.

periods.summary: Kanata takes center stage in the fourth side story. She provides the real poltergeist footage for the student council's ghost-story party and steers the group into a test of courage. Paired with Ikki, she asks naïve questions about kissing because her arranged-marriage future limits her chance for ordinary romance. She later reveals a mischievous side by using Diamond Dust and a wig to scare Stella and Toka. When the real culprit appears, she supports Ikki with invisible blade dust, creates midair footholds and cushions his fall. After they capture the telekinetic monkey, she arranges its protection through a Tokutomiya foundation and explains that preserving the family system to fund such charities is her own chivalry.

key_events.summary: Organizes and joins the school poltergeist search, then supports Ikki in capturing the culprit.
Explains her arranged-marriage future and her commitment to noblesse oblige after protecting the monkey.

status.current: watches the semifinals with Toka and supports the delayed final

personality.summary: Polite and perceptive, often commenting calmly on the scale of the battles before her.

abilities_owned: Scarlet Lady abilities not demonstrated in this volume

relationships.toka-todo: Arrives with Toka to watch the semifinals.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Recognizes the astonishing scale of Stella's battle.

periods.summary: Kanata attends the semifinals with Toka and Nene. She remarks on Stella's improved expression and the astonishing scale of the Stella-Ouma fight, and listens as Ikki explains Ouma's uncompromising pursuit of strength. She later appears among the people waiting for Ikki to wake so the final with Stella can still be held.

key_events.summary: Watches and comments on the A-rank semifinal.
Joins the supporters cheering the delayed final.

periods.label: 接应学生会的贵德原彼方
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy student council; Tokutomiya family

status.current: hosts the student council group in Osaka and watches the final

relationships.toka-todo: Knows Toka has a separate urgent matter before the final.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Guides him and the others to her family's hotel.

periods.summary: Kanata meets the student council group at the crowded station while fully covered against the sun. She explains Toka's temporary absence, notes that Prime Minister Tsukikage helped with the unprecedented final delay, and guides everyone to a Tokutomiya-family hotel. During the final she notices Ikki's defensive ingenuity with Toka and the others.

key_events.summary: Receives the student council group and explains the postponement context.
Observes Ikki's shoulder-dislocation shock absorption and defensive trickery.

periods.label: 以漫画腰斩威胁凛奈
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy student council; Tokutomiya Group

status.current: successfully deters Rinna from future Rebellion involvement
status.condition: uses social and corporate leverage rather than force

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Elite acquaintance whom she warns away from battlefields.
relationships.charlotte-corday: Receives clarification from Charlotte about Rinna's status.
relationships.toka-todo: Student council colleague present at the party.

periods.summary: Kanata attends Ikki's victory party and intentionally approaches Rinna. Having experienced real anti-Rebellion operations through special summons, she does not want to meet acquaintances on a battlefield. When Rinna refuses in chuunibyou fashion, Kanata reveals that the publisher of Rinna's beloved manga is tied to the Tokutomiya group and pretends to arrange its cancellation if Rinna remains on a dark path. The tactic works immediately and Rinna begs her not to cancel the series.

key_events.summary: Uses publishing leverage to make Rinna abandon future Akatsuki/Rebellion participation.

periods.time: Japan's special conscription and return to Fukuoka
periods.label: 腥红淑女支援徵召与若叶之家
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Tokutomiya Foundation; Wakaba House

status.current: supports Wakaba House legally and socially while helping Toka evaluate Harima

relationships.toka-todo: Childhood friend from Wakaba House; she helps restrain Toka and advises her.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Childhood friend and fellow returnee to Wakaba House.
relationships.harima-tendo: Suspicious elder whose organizational skills she notices.
relationships.toshiko-nishikata: Director of Wakaba House, supported by the Tokutomiya charity foundation.

periods.summary: Kanata helps special conscription by infiltrating the Dragunov underground arena from the emergency exit, using her particle-like blood-red blades to cut down armed guards and enable Toka to arrest Smiley. After the conscription debrief she returns to Fukuoka with Toka and Uta. When neighborhood mothers deny responsibility for their children's vandalism, Kanata uses the Tokutomiya Foundation's legal authority to force compensation without escalating unnecessarily. She also helps investigate Harima Tendo's identity and recognizes that his volunteer-work plan and public relations tactics are unusually practiced, suggesting experience leading an organization.

key_events.summary: Disables armed guards and helps collapse the underground arena from within.
Protects Wakaba House through legal pressure and later joins volunteer image-building work.

periods.time: Kyushu charitable work and emergency evacuation
periods.label: 贵德原家的救灾协调
titles: 贵德原慈善基金会总务助理
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Tokutomiya Charity Foundation; International Mage-Knight League emergency response

status.current: supports Kyushu evacuation and power-grid restoration while protecting civilians with glass barriers
status.condition: tired but active throughout the disaster

relationships.toka-todo: Close friend; warns Misogi and later arranges Nishikata to emotionally support Toka.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Calls him after Toka cannot be reached, starting the rescue chain.
relationships.nishikata-hisako: Works with the Wakaba House director and asks her to care for Toka.
relationships.harima-tendo: Initially sees him as a helpful old man; learns from Itsuki that he is Daien.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Meets him when he arrives by teleport, later helps provide Ayatsuji's contact for Kuraudo.

periods.summary: Kanata is working at the Tokutomiya Charity Foundation when Itsuki Kurogane informs her that Harima Tendo, the old man sheltered by Wakaba House, is the escaped criminal Daien. She fails to reach Toka, reaches Misogi, and joins the evacuation effort. After Fukuoka's destruction, she explains the disaster situation to Toka in Miyazaki, helps organize civilian boats and local evacuation, and recognizes that Toka needs emotional support more than orders. Kanata asks Nishikata to stay with Toka, later protects power-line workers from Tendo's lightning with her glass barriers, and contributes to the collective operation that lets Toka defeat Daien.

key_events.summary: Receives Itsuki's warning and alerts Misogi that Tendo is dangerous.
Briefs Toka on the five days of disaster, evacuation, and Misogi's injury.
Finds Nishikata among refugees and asks her to care for Toka's breaking heart.
Protects repair teams with glass walls during the grid restoration.
